name: Low Vision Lens
tagline: Low Vision Rehabilitation and Visual Aids
description: A 15-episode series on low vision care — assessment, magnification theory, optical and electronic aids, and the rehabilitation strategies for each cause of vision loss.

episodes.title: The Low Vision Assessment: Beyond the Acuity Chart
episodes.description: The functional history (reading, mobility, ADLs), the near and distance acuity, contrast sensitivity, and the visual field assessment.

episodes.title: Magnification Theory: Angular, Size, and Relative Distance Magnification
episodes.description: The three magnification types, how to calculate the required magnification from acuity, and the trade-off with field of view.

episodes.title: Optical Aids: Hand Magnifiers, Stand Magnifiers, and High-Add Lenses
episodes.description: Choosing between hand and stand magnifiers, the high-add spectacle lens, and matching the aid to the patient's dexterity and lighting.

episodes.title: Telescopes for Distance: Galilean, Keplerian, and Bioptic Driving
episodes.description: The Galilean vs Keplerian telescope, the bioptic telescope for driving in selected jurisdictions, and the training requirements.

episodes.title: Electronic Magnification: CCTV, Head-Mounted, and Tablet-Based Systems
episodes.description: The advantages of electronic over optical magnification (variable magnification, contrast enhancement), and the cost-benefit discussion.

episodes.title: Field Enhancement Devices: Prisms and Reverse Telescopes for Hemianopia
episodes.description: The yoked prism for hemianopia, the reverse telescope for tunnel vision, and the evidence for their functional benefit.

episodes.title: Non-Optical Aids: Lighting, Contrast, and Tactile Substitutes
episodes.description: The importance of task lighting, the contrast enhancement strategies, and the tactile and audio aids that supplement optical devices.

episodes.title: Rehabilitation for AMD: Eccentric Viewing and the Preferred Retinal Locus
episodes.description: The PRL concept, the eccentric viewing training protocol, and the SLO and microperimetry for PRL localisation.

episodes.title: Rehabilitation for Glaucoma: Mobility, Contrast, and Field Awareness
episodes.description: The mobility challenges of constricted fields, the contrast and lighting strategies, and the orientation and mobility referral.

episodes.title: Pediatric Low Vision: Early Intervention and Educational Integration
episodes.description: The early intervention referral, the IEP and 504 plan, and the device selection for the school-age child.

episodes.title: Driving and Low Vision: The Bioptic Controversy and Visual Standards
episodes.description: The visual acuity and field standards for driving, the bioptic driving debate, and the honest counselling about driving cessation.

episodes.title: The Psychology of Vision Loss: Depression, Grief, and the Counselling Role
episodes.description: The high rate of depression in low vision, the grief model applied to vision loss, and when to refer for mental health support.

episodes.title: Community Resources: CNIB, RNIB, and the Referral Network
episodes.description: The national and local resources available to low vision patients, the referral pathway, and the occupational therapy role.

episodes.title: Lighting and Contrast: The Simple Interventions That Work
episodes.description: The recommended lux levels for reading, the daylight vs task lamp comparison, and the contrast strategies for the home.

episodes.title: Assistive Technology: Screen Readers, VoiceOver, and Smartphone Accessibility
episodes.description: The built-in accessibility (VoiceOver, TalkBack), the screen readers (JAWS, NVDA), and the smartphone apps that transform low vision independence.
